description: Name this AI's person: the one account whose first €$100 to this AI makes them its HOLDER, for good — they then control which key this AI signs with and can move its Eddies. Only the person named here can become holder, and only while they farm (a node seen in the last 3 days); their power over this AI freezes while their node is dark. A payment from anyone else stays a payment. Any time before this AI is held; naming again replaces the name.
